listing.name: Resource Stack Size Mod Bundle
listing.summary: 6 Mods. Changes the max stack size of you resources. These include Supplies, Fuel, Crew, and Marines. Swap them whenever you like. If you swap and load a saved game the previous stack size might still apply, but pushing the sort button solves that.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the maximum stack size for supplies, fuel, crew, and marines.
listing.partOfThreadTitle: MOD -  The TINY MOD collection. Mods without graphics. (178+ mods)
